content.title: ‘The White Lotus’ Adds Ari Graynor & Dylan Ennis To Season 4 Cast
content.text: Skip to main content ‘The White Lotus’ Adds Ari Graynor & Dylan Ennis To Season 4 Cast Ari Graynor and Dylan Ennis Phil Chester Sara Byrne/Stewart Bywater Ari Graynor (Monsters: The Lyle and Erik Menendez Story) and newcomer Dylan Ennis are the latest cast additions to Season 4 of Mike White’s Emmy-winning HBO series The White Lotus. Filming in France, the season once again will follow a group of White Lotus hotel guests and employees over the span of a week. Graynor and Ennis join previously announced Sandra Bernhard, Helena Bonham Carter, Steve Coogan, Caleb Jonte Edwards, Marissa Long, Alexander Ludwig, Chris Messina and AJ Michalka, with casting ongoing. Related Stories The White Lotus‘ setup follows the stories of multiple groups of White Lotus guests, which can run parallel or intersect. Graynor’s character is believed to be paired with Messina’s. Ennis is thought to be playing a local as the London-based young performer is of French/Jamaican heritage. Created, written and directed by Mike White, Season 4 is executive produced by White, David Bernad and Mark Kamine. Graynor recently played defense attorney Leslie Abramson in Netflix’s Monsters: The Lyle and Erik Menendez Story. She also was a series regular on I’m Dying Up Here and Surface and recurred on Winning Time: The Rise of the Lakers Dynasty. Graynor is repped by Gersh, Entertainment 360 and LGN Law. Ennis is a recent LAMDA graduate who will make his TV debut in the upcoming Channel 4 series Pierre. He is repped by UK’s Conway van Gelder Grant. This could be a career-making turn for Ennis. The White Lotus is known for breaking young talent, with Season 2’s Leo Woodall and Haley Lu Richardson among those who were catapulted into stardom by the show.
